summary: Every slide template, generated from templates/library by tools/build_catalog.py. Tier 'core' is a slide type in its simplest useful form; 'working' is a dense working slide rebuilt from a real proposal (legacy names the pptxgengo catalog reference).

families.name: Openers and structure
families.summary: Covers, agendas, dividers, key messages, quotes and closings: the slides that frame a deck.

families.name: Argument and frameworks
families.summary: Pillars, comparisons, from-to shifts, problem framing and capability frameworks that carry the storyline.

families.name: Evidence and data
families.summary: Stats, charts, 2x2s, status and image-led evidence.

families.name: Solution and architecture
families.summary: Architecture views, process flows, workstreams and readiness criteria.

families.name: Approach and plan
families.summary: Phases, phase detail, gates, roadmaps, work plans, cutover and method.

families.name: Commercials
families.summary: Pricing by option, milestone and capacity run-rate, and optional scope.

families.name: Team and governance
families.summary: Org charts, pods, rosters, bios, roles by phase and governance.

families.name: Proof and reference
families.summary: Case studies, client proof, firm overview, history, sample deliverables and appendix references.

templates.name: Cover · photo with contacts
templates.purpose: Opening slide for a proposal: logo, client, display title, preparer and two contacts on White; a photo bleeding off the right edge, framed by an L of dots.

templates.name: Cover · whiteboard grid and stat square
templates.purpose: Opening slide that leads with a number: whiteboard dot grid with one inverse stat square.

templates.name: Agenda · left panel with photo
templates.purpose: Section overview with page references. The title sits on the dark panel; a photo breaks out across the panel edge, over a column of dots.

templates.name: Agenda · schedule rows
templates.purpose: Timed agenda for a workshop or readout: time keys on the left, one outcome on the right.

templates.name: Agenda · sessions, contributions and results
templates.purpose: A working-session day as rows: the session and its time, what each side contributes, and the shared result at the end of the session.

templates.name: Divider · panel with breakout photo
templates.purpose: A Grounded panel holds the section number and title; a photo crosses the panel edge onto the dot field.

templates.name: Divider · panel with Magenta edge
templates.purpose: Grounded panel with a Magenta edge and the section label; the photo fills the white side, over a band of dots.

templates.name: Divider · full-bleed photo
templates.purpose: A full-bleed photo with the number and title on a Grounded block anchored bottom-left; dots run across the block's top edge.

templates.name: Divider · light with photo square
templates.purpose: Opens a section on White: oversized section number, display title, a photo square over the dot field.

templates.name: Divider · inverse with photo
templates.purpose: Opens a section on Grounded Blue: display title low-left, an abstract photo square top-right, Dark Gray dots beneath it.

templates.name: Key message · claim with one proof
templates.purpose: One claim in the title; the key message at title size and its support at lead size, centered as a group in the body beside one number that proves it.

templates.name: Key message · statement
templates.purpose: The message is the slide: a display-size statement centered on White, with one line of support and the dot field to its right.

templates.name: Narrative · lead and three points
templates.purpose: A short argument in prose at reading width: one lead sentence, three lead-in points.

templates.name: Cards · three columns
templates.purpose: Three parallel ideas as numbered cards with a Grounded Blue band.

templates.name: Cards · four columns
templates.purpose: Four short parallel ideas on subtle cards with inline numbers.

templates.name: Quote · light
templates.purpose: A client voice in their own words at heading size, with a single quiet square.

templates.name: Quote · inverse
templates.purpose: The same quote on Grounded Blue for a section or deck opener.

templates.name: Closing · tagline
templates.purpose: Brand sign-off on Grounded Blue with the tagline and one next step.

templates.name: Argument with takeaway rail
templates.purpose: Evidence on the left and the so-what in a dark right rail.

templates.name: From to, two cards
templates.purpose: Contrast the current state (subtle) with the target state (inverse) and one hand-drawn arrow.

templates.name: From to, paired rows
templates.purpose: Row-by-row shift from today to the target state, with a metric on the target side.

templates.name: Transformation · before and after
templates.purpose: Paired rows of today against the target model, with a transition arrow and a Magenta tag for each result.

templates.name: Transformation · pain points to design themes
templates.purpose: Pair each current pain point with the design theme that answers it, joined by an arrow, with one closing statement of how the problems were solved.

templates.name: Method · what it is and seven steps
templates.purpose: A proprietary method on one page: a panel that says what it is, what the client gets and why it works, beside the seven steps of how it runs.

templates.name: Pillars · four, each with why it matters
templates.purpose: Set out four principles of an approach, each with its practices and an offset Grounded panel stating why it matters to the client.

templates.name: Capability table · focus, AI role, human judgment
templates.purpose: Walk a five-step progression in one table with a tile per step, what the technology does, where human judgment stays, and a one-line takeaway.

templates.name: Capability map · six layered bands
templates.purpose: Show an operating or architecture model as ruled bands, each with a label column and rows of blocks that span the width in different splits.

templates.name: Flow · challenges to products, use cases and outcomes
templates.purpose: Trace a causal chain from challenges through products and use cases to outcomes, in four framed zones joined by arrows, with a closing statement.

templates.name: Problem · two causes, one statistic and a remedy
templates.purpose: Frame a problem with a lead sentence, two causes in icon cards, one Grounded statistic card that carries the headline number, and a one-line remedy strip.

templates.name: Decision · two options and the shifting economics
templates.purpose: Compare two options side by side with when each fits and its trade-offs, and set the changing economics in a wider third column, ending on a decision rule.

templates.name: Objective · numbered rationale beside a Grounded outcomes panel
templates.purpose: State a session or program objective with three numbered reasons on the left and a Grounded panel of six outcomes in two columns on the right.

templates.name: Session · step sequence with a guidance panel
templates.purpose: Lay out how a working session runs as a four-step vertical sequence, with a Grounded panel on facilitation and a closing ask of participants.

templates.name: Goal and steps · target band over three timed steps
templates.purpose: Open with a Grounded goal band and a target outcome, then three timed numbered steps each with a facilitator note, and a closing expected-outcome bar.

templates.name: Comparison · our way versus others, with six implications
templates.purpose: Contrast two ways of working in paired lists, then spell out six implications for the client with an icon tile each, beside a short narrative and a handover callout.

templates.name: Hub and eight spokes
templates.purpose: A dark hub of benefits ringed by eight supporting capabilities, each tied to the hub with an arrow.

templates.name: Frameworks · layers, examples and emphasis
templates.purpose: Lay out a set of numbered framework layers with public examples, what each emphasizes and its maturity, closing with a call to action.

templates.name: Key stats, four metrics
templates.purpose: Four headline numbers that prove one claim, with a single supporting sentence.

templates.name: Key stats, circled headline
templates.purpose: One circled headline number with two supporting metric cards.

templates.name: Chart, full width
templates.purpose: One column chart across the slide, with the takeaway in the title and the key bars highlighted.

templates.name: Chart with takeaway rail
templates.purpose: A clustered chart on the left and the so-what in a dark right rail.

templates.name: 2x2 assessment, subtle
templates.purpose: Rank initiatives by value and effort; the aim-here quadrant is tinted, the avoid quadrant hatched.

templates.name: 2x2 assessment, strong
templates.purpose: One filled quadrant to stay out of, with movement arrows and a short note alongside.

templates.name: Image with text, square
templates.purpose: A photo square beside the point it supports and two short proof lines.

templates.name: Image with text, wide frame
templates.purpose: Text on the left with a 16:9 photo on the right and a one-line caption.

templates.name: Status dashboard, four panels
templates.purpose: Four panels on one grid: two metric cards with status, a wave table and an adoption card.

templates.name: Value · capacity to banked savings
templates.purpose: A stacked capacity chart that shows effort moving from manual work to priority work and savings, paired with the five governance steps that make the value count.

templates.name: Architecture · layer stack
templates.purpose: A numbered layer stack inside one frame: the experience layer first, three rows beneath, and a cross-cutting controls column.

templates.name: Architecture · nested view
templates.purpose: A nested deployment view: source systems outside, one cloud tenant, one finance platform boundary, and two layers inside.

templates.name: Architecture · legend and layer map
templates.purpose: A colour-keyed legend of the five architecture layers beside a dense six-group component map: users, lifecycle, platform services, governance, placement and ecosystem.

templates.name: Architecture · inputs, core and integrations
templates.purpose: A three-zone product architecture (inputs, analysis core with a database, integrations), a dark panel of differentiators and a value strip of three headline numbers.

templates.name: Reference architecture · platform map
templates.purpose: A narrative column (proof points and dependencies) beside a detailed platform map: a cross-cutting bar, sources, three data stores, consumption, platform services and three principles.

templates.name: Process · swimlane
templates.purpose: Who does what, in order: four actor lanes, one decision, two flagged pain points and a one-line key.

templates.name: Five workstreams with a risk band
templates.purpose: Five numbered workstream headers, activities under each, and a full-width band of five risks if the work is not done right.

templates.name: Context flow · carried, layered, applied
templates.purpose: Three zones read left to right: context carried forward, a central panel with a five-step chain, and four numbered build activities, closed by a one-line shift statement.

templates.name: Foundation with Build and Sustain panels
templates.purpose: A shared-foundation card beside two stacked panels, one dark and one light, each with a how-it-is-used and a value-opportunity column, closed by a dark statement bar.

templates.name: Three patterns with decisions to validate
templates.purpose: Three stacked pattern rows, each with a coloured header, a flow line and role statement, and a right column of decisions to validate.

templates.name: Readiness criteria · six checklists
templates.purpose: A dark statement panel overlapping the top of a light region that holds six criteria groups of three checks each.

templates.name: Two pathways with a left rail
templates.purpose: A dark left rail with the key message and four commitments beside two five-step chevron pathways and a result bar.

templates.name: Work plan · eight weeks
templates.purpose: An eight-week work plan: three workstreams, phase bands, gates, workshops and soft starts, for the detailed plan a steering group signs off.

templates.name: Phased approach · four phases
templates.purpose: The approach as four phases, each with objective, activities, deliverables and a closing gate.

templates.name: Phases · key activities and outcome
templates.purpose: Three consecutive phases as arrows sized to their weeks, each with a number, name, key activities and one outcome, so a steering group reads the whole arc at once.

templates.name: Phases · summary, activities and deliverables
templates.purpose: Three phase columns under arrow heads: a one-line summary band, a block of activities and a block of deliverables, aligned across phases so they compare row by row.

templates.name: Phase detail · activities and work products
templates.purpose: One phase on one page: a rail with the phase name, objective and exit criteria; activities and work products by workstream; deliverable thumbnails and assumptions.

templates.name: Phase detail · repeatable process matrix
templates.purpose: A phase rail beside a step-by-step matrix of platform service, workload activity and evidence, with the fixed and variable scope stated underneath.

templates.name: Phase detail · scorecard and cohort
templates.purpose: A phase rail carrying the selection scorecard, beside three illustrative workloads that each validate one pattern, with a thumbnail of the architecture each touches.

templates.name: Phase · team handoff over time
templates.purpose: Show how responsibility shifts between consulting and client teams across two phases, with an effort curve, a callout and a row per team.

templates.name: Phase gate · criteria, exit and owner
templates.purpose: The decision rule for a phase gate: five numbered criteria, the evidence each requires, an illustrative exit and one named decision owner.

templates.name: Roadmap · staggered phases and milestones
templates.purpose: A months-based roadmap where each phase starts as the last one settles: staggered bars with hatched extension windows, starred milestones, and an ongoing program lane.

templates.name: Cutover · AI support and wave matrix
templates.purpose: How a phased cutover is run: three kinds of AI support across every wave, then a slice-by-wave matrix showing legacy, coexistence and modern state.

templates.name: Pricing · three options
templates.purpose: Present two to three engagement options side by side with one recommended, so the client compares scope and fee on one page.

templates.name: Pricing · fixed fee by milestone
templates.purpose: Show a fixed fee as payments tied to milestones, with one summary of the total and terms. Never itemize by person.

templates.name: Pricing · capacity run-rate
templates.purpose: Show a capacity-based team as allocations and one monthly run-rate, never as individual rates.

templates.name: Scope · optional services, scope and value
templates.purpose: Optional scope laid out by service: what is added, the value it unlocks and how it is priced, in one dense table a sponsor can strike items from.

templates.name: Team · org chart
templates.purpose: Who leads and who reports to whom across West Monroe and Northfield, with a dotted line to the controller.

templates.name: Team · pods and roles
templates.purpose: The team as three delivery pods plus the client roles that work beside them; simpler than a tree when reporting lines do not matter.

templates.name: Team structure · org chart with roles
templates.purpose: Show a joint client and consulting team as one org chart with liaisons and optional roles, paired with a table of what each role does.

templates.name: Team structure · pods and leadership pairs
templates.purpose: Show leadership pairs across both organizations, workstream leads and delivery pods that scale by phase, with the client's role commitments beside them.

templates.name: Team · roster in two tiers
templates.purpose: List a named roster in two tiers, leadership and specialists, each with a short description of what the tier does.

templates.name: Governance · three tiers
templates.purpose: How decisions are made: three tiers with cadence, members and decision rights, and an escalation path upward.

templates.name: Full-page bio · portrait and quote
templates.purpose: One person in full: square portrait on the rail, role, background, selected experience and a client quote. A template, not a card.

templates.name: Full-page bio · tall portrait, right panel
templates.purpose: A quieter full-page bio without a quote: tall portrait on a right panel, role, background and a longer list of experience. Shown with the optional greyscale photo treatment.

templates.name: Team bios · three cards
templates.purpose: Introduce three people at once with mini bio cards: photo or initials, role, credentials and two proof points.

templates.name: Team · leadership bios with specialist row
templates.purpose: Introduce four engagement leaders as mini bios with credentials and proof points, plus a row of on-call specialists.

templates.name: Roles · responsibilities by phase
templates.purpose: Appendix table of roles against phases with what each role owns in each phase and who is responsible.

templates.name: Case study · full page
templates.purpose: One past engagement told on a full page: image, challenge, approach, and three results on a right rail. Built from an image, header, text blocks and metrics, not a card.

templates.name: Case study · full page with quote
templates.purpose: Full-width case study: image, two text blocks, three results and a client quote. Use when a quote carries the proof.

templates.name: Case study · narrative, exhibits and results
templates.purpose: Anonymized case study with a situation and approach narrative, an architecture exhibit, headline results and a question-to-value mapping.

templates.name: Three case studies
templates.purpose: Three mini case study cards with client-scale badges. The badges overhang the top-right corners inside the content margin.

templates.name: Two case studies
templates.purpose: Two wider case study cards with a third action line each, for a tighter story.

templates.name: Proof · result cards and client quotes
templates.purpose: Back a proposal with two anonymized result cards, two headline survey statistics and a row of client quotes.

templates.name: RFP requirements map
templates.purpose: Reference table that maps each RFP requirement to how the response meets it and where. Appendix density, with a continued caption for tables that run over.

templates.name: Confidentiality notice
templates.purpose: A calm text slide: a lead paragraph, a rule and three short notes. The stamp carries the status.

templates.name: Partnership history
templates.purpose: A time axis with four milestones, three short year notes beneath and one Magenta callout for where the work leads.

templates.name: Outcomes · three client programs
templates.purpose: Prove one claim with three comparable client programs, each with its situation, two headline metrics and the business value delivered.

templates.name: Offerings and capabilities · three panels
templates.purpose: A lead statement with alliance chips, a dark panel of industry offerings in three groups, and a light panel of four capability groups.

templates.name: Sample deliverables · four columns of exhibits
templates.purpose: Show the rigor behind each deliverable: four columns, each with a name, a one-line scope and two sample exhibits.

templates.name: About us · firm at a glance
templates.purpose: Summarize the firm: a positioning statement, a client quote, what and where we work, and three proof statistics on a dark panel.
